title: SynbotHealth — Royan Hospital System Requirements
subtitle: Defining Your Digital Hospital
description: This questionnaire helps the SynbotHealth team understand exactly how Royan Hospital operates today — and where you want the system to take you. Answers will directly shape the modules we configure, the workflows we automate, and the integrations we prioritise. Estimated time: 25–35 minutes.

intro_questions.label: Approximately how many inpatient beds does Royan Hospital currently operate?

Yes — DRM Hope is installed but not fully in use
No — we use different software (please specify below)
No — we do not currently use any HMS
